cards.text: Micah, a prophet of the LORD, is already in the middle of his message to God's people, and now he aims it straight at the top. The prophet says, 'Hear now, O leaders of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel.' Friend, when a prophet opens with 'Hear now,' that's the 'we need to talk' text, and he's got a question for them.

cards.question: Micah asks the leaders of Jacob and the rulers of Israel a question. Of all people, shouldn't they know ___?
The leaders of Jacob should know justice. Micah says they love good and hate evil.

cards.text: Nope, they've got it BACKWARDS: Micah says they hate good and love evil. Then he hits them with this: 'You tear the skin from my people and strip the flesh from their bones.'

cards.question: Micah keeps that rough picture going. He says the leaders of Jacob chop up the people like what?

cards.text: Then Micah says a time is coming when these same leaders will cry out to the LORD. Cry OUT, like me yelling HELP at the oven when the smoke alarm goes off over a batch.

cards.question: A time is coming when the leaders of Jacob will cry out to the LORD. What will He do?

answers.text: He will answer them right away
He will send them a new king

cards.question: Micah says the LORD will hide His face from these leaders because of the evil they have done.

cards.text: Now the LORD speaks about the prophets who lead His people astray. These prophets proclaim peace while they chew with their teeth, so it's peace, peace, PEACE, with their mouths full.

cards.question: These prophets proclaim peace while they chew. But against someone who puts nothing in their mouths, they declare ___.

cards.text: So the LORD says night will come over these prophets without visions, and the daylight will turn black over them. Signal from heaven? ZERO bars.

cards.question: Once the visions are gone, the seers and diviners are honored for their honesty.
The seers and diviners all end up covering their mouths. Why?

answers.text: There is no answer from God
The leaders ordered them to be quiet
They are afraid of the angry crowds

cards.text: Then the prophet Micah says, 'As for me, however,' and the whole tone changes. Those prophets are standing there with their hands over their mouths, and Micah walks in with something they DON'T have.

cards.question: Micah says he is filled with power by the ___ of the LORD.
Micah is filled with power, justice and courage. What does he declare to Jacob and Israel?

cards.text: Then Micah calls out the leaders of Jacob and rulers of Israel again, and this is round TWO. He says they despise justice and pervert all that is right.

cards.question: Micah says these leaders build Zion with ___ and Jerusalem with iniquity.

cards.text: Then Micah goes down Jerusalem's list, and her leaders judge for a bribe, which is a courtroom with a TIP JAR. Her prophets? They practice divination for money.

cards.question: In Jerusalem, Micah says, the priests are the ones who teach for free.
Bribes and price tags all over Jerusalem, and yet they lean on the LORD. What do they say?

answers.text: The LORD is among us so no disaster can come
The LORD has left us so we should repent now
The LORD is angry so we must hide from Him

cards.text: Then Micah says what's coming because of them, and he starts with Zion. Friend, this is the part where I'd quietly hop my gold base right out of the kitchen.

cards.question: Micah tells the leaders and rulers he's calling out, 'Therefore, because of you,' and then names what happens to Zion. What is it?

answers.text: It will be plowed like a field
It will be rebuilt with gold
It will be ruled by Egypt

cards.question: Micah says that even as Jerusalem falls, the temple mount will be spared.

cards.text: Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, and the temple mount a wooded ridge. That's where Micah's warning lands, friend, and it does NOT land soft.
